description: Chrome-level hint mode for the Thunderbird UI.

functions.name: getStatus
functions.description: Report which windows Vimbird is attached to and whether hint mode is active.

functions.name: dumpCandidates
functions.description: List, per document, how many elements would be hinted right now.

functions.name: startHintMode
functions.description: Start hint mode in the active window, as pressing 'f' would.

functions.name: sendHintInput
functions.description: Feed hint characters to an active hint session.

functions.name: cancelHintMode
functions.description: Cancel hint mode, as pressing Escape would.
